item.title: Winter weather advisory issued for Rensselaer County until Saturday evening — possibly 5 inches of snow
item.description: A winter weather advisory was issued by the National Weather Service on Friday at 12:42 a.m. valid from 7 p.m. until Saturday 7 p.m. for Rensselaer County.

item.title: Cold weather advisory in place for Capital Region for Saturday and Sunday — dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: The National Weather Service released a cold weather advisory at 12:55 a.m. on Friday valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Southeast Warren as well as Saratoga, Washington, Schenectady, Albany, Rensselaer, Greene and Columbia counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning for Capital Region and Hudson Valley for Saturday and Sunday
item.description: On Friday at 12:55 a.m. an extreme cold warning was issued by the National Weather Service valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Rensselaer, Columbia, Ulster and Dutchess counties.

item.title: Northern Warren placed under an extreme cold warning Saturday and Sunday — extremely cold conditions
item.description: An extreme cold warning was released by the National Weather Service on Friday at 12:55 a.m. valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Northern Warren.

item.title: Extreme cold warning issued for parts of Upstate NY for Saturday and Sunday — wind chills as low as -35
item.description: At 12:55 a.m. on Friday, the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold warning valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Herkimer, Hamilton, Fulton, Montgomery, Schoharie, Schenectady, Albany, Greene and Ulster counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning in place for parts of Upstate NY for Saturday and Sunday — extremely cold conditions
item.description: On Friday at 1:03 a.m. the National Weather Service released an extreme cold warning valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Otsego, Delaware and Sullivan counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning in place for parts of Upstate NY for Saturday and Sunday — wind chills as low as -30
item.description: The National Weather Service issued an extreme cold warning at 1:03 a.m. on Friday valid from Saturday 4 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oneida, Yates, Seneca, Cayuga, Onondaga, Steuben, Schuyler, Chemung, Tompkins, Madison, Cortland, Chenango, Tioga and Broome counties.

item.title: Western NY and Finger Lakes under an extreme cold warning Saturday and Sunday — dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: The National Weather Service released an extreme cold warning at 1:03 a.m. on Friday valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Wyoming, Livingston, Ontario, Chautauqua, Cattaraugus, Allegany and Erie counties.

item.title: Central NY and North Country placed under an extreme cold warning Saturday and Sunday — extremely cold conditions
item.description: The National Weather Service released an extreme cold warning at 1:03 a.m. on Friday valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oswego, Jefferson and Lewis counties.

item.title: Cold weather advisory affecting Western NY and Finger Lakes Saturday and Sunday — dangerous wind chills expected
item.description: At 1:03 a.m. on Friday, the National Weather Service released a cold weather advisory valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Niagara, Orleans, Monroe, Wayne, Cayuga, Erie and Genesee counties.
